subject: Logic
title: Your Brain Cheats
description: A short lesson to help you apply Your Brain Cheats.

hook.text: You think you see the world clearly. Your brain disagrees—it's been cutting corners all day.

buildup.text: Cognitive biases are systematic thinking errors wired into every human mind.

discovery.text: Kahneman and Tversky cataloged dozens in the 1970s. We now know of over 180 distinct biases.

twist.text: Biases aren't bugs—they're shortcuts that helped ancestors survive but misfire in modern life.

climax.text: Recognizing a bias doesn't remove it, but it lets you pause before it hijacks a decision.

punchline.text: Your brain is fast. Not fair.
